title: Great Book 2024 — Science and Mathematics Archaeology
purpose: Trace scientific, mathematical and systems ideas already present in the 2024 Great Book stratum before the mature April-2025 Axis/Spiral threshold and 2026 Timic Dynamics formalization. Later equations are linked as descendants only when the conceptual genealogy is defensible.
epistemic_rule: Book language can prefigure later scientific formalization without being an established physical theory. Later mathematics must not be backdated into 2024 as if the book contained equations it did not contain.

concepts.book_formula: resistance / karmic inertia → surrender / collapse → ego dissolution → reconstitution → Potato freedom
concepts.book_science_language: Quantum and singularity language appears in the source as metaphor/theorycrafting.
concepts.boundary: No quantum collapse or spacetime singularity is established by the book narrative.

concepts.book_structure: Two opposed/counter-moving triangle-like forces remain differentiated while a stable dynamic center emerges.
concepts.status_note: Rotation matrices and oscillator order parameters are archive formalizations, not recovered book equations.

concepts.book_structure: Potato mediates past/future, mundane/divine, root/sprout and inside/outside.
concepts.boundary: A symbolic boundary is not automatically a physical membrane or quantum boundary condition.

concepts.book_structure: Potato is compared metaphorically to an excitation in a Field of Life.
concepts.research_question: If Field of Life is ever promoted beyond metaphor, what are its degrees of freedom, symmetry, action, coupling and observable excitations?
concepts.boundary: No biological or spiritual 'life field' is established by quantum field theory.

concepts.book_structure: One form contains/branches into many possible futures.
concepts.external_equation: |Ψ⟩ → Σ_i c_i |system_i⟩|observer_i⟩ under unitary entangling evolution
concepts.boundary: Narrative possibility or vegetative multiplication is not evidence that macroscopic Potterverse branches are physical Everett worlds.

concepts.book_structure: A simple exterior may conceal or encode deeper relational structure.
concepts.boundary: The book metaphor does not imply ordinary potatoes or everyday reality satisfy an AdS/CFT duality.
Symbolic past/future polarity should not be equated with advanced/retarded electromagnetic propagation absent primary evidence.

concepts.book_structure: Breath turns static geometry into lived/dynamic flow by joining upper and lower.
external_neighbors: control input u(t) in state equations
concepts.archive_formalization: dX/dt=F(X,u(t)); breath can be modeled only as an input on a defined physiological or symbolic state system, not as a universal force.

concepts.book_structure: Return is transformed recurrence rather than restoration of an unchanged past.
concepts.boundary: These external theories instantiate precise forms of nontrivial return; they do not establish the book's spiritual claims.

concepts.book_law: multiplication is not the opposite of unity; multiplication can be the mode by which unity survives transformation
candidate_math: graph diffusion x_{t+1}=Mx_t in a simple linear model
concepts.status_note: These equations are later comparators, not book equations.

concepts.book_structure: Money, healthcare, education, security, incentives, information and oversight are treated as one coupled feedback system.
candidate_math: multilayer adjacency tensor or supra-adjacency matrix
concepts.importance: This is an early systems-science precursor in the corpus, separate from the later sacred-geometric layer.

genealogy: 2024: boundary / counter-rotation / field / branching / holographic depth / transformed return
2025: Axis becomes explicit; Spiral Equation attested; Needle/Turning reorganizes the architecture
2026: Potato Dynamics, topology, Standard Model, quantum information, dimensional compactification and systems mathematics make the older intuitions explicit
